Gold Sequin Halter Maxi Dress

Elegant and glamorous gold sequin maxi dress, designed with a fitted bodycon silhouette that highlights the figure beautifully. The dress features a sleeveless halter neckline, ruched detailing, and sparkling sequin fabric for a luxurious evening look. Perfect for weddings, birthday parties, evening events, formal occasions, and special celebrations.

Specifications:

Material: Sequins / Polyester blend

Color: Gold / Same as picture

Neckline: Halter neck

Sleeves: Sleeveless

Length: Maxi / Long dress

Fit: Slim fit / Bodycon

Design: Ruched details with full sequin finish

Closure: Back zipper

Occasion: Party, evening, wedding, birthday, formal event

Style: Elegant, sexy, luxury evening wear
